name: Refined Copper
description: Bright and polished, small bricks with edges still rough, cooling atop stone slabs, ready but unworked.

name: Refined Bronze
description: Golden and lustrous, stacked as rough billets beside smelting tools, surface gleaming but not yet hammered thin.

name: Refined Iron
description: Heavy and dark, cooling in a line of mottled bars, streaks of slag clinging, unfinished.

name: Refined Silver
description: A bar of brilliant white gleam, resting in tongs over a water trough, magical runes just visible on the cooling surface.

name: Refined Gold
description: Pure and radiant, twisted into a crude ingot, lying atop a silken pad, edges untouched and glowing with promise.

name: Refined Star Metal
description: Midnight blue shot with radiant veins, a slab resting in a rune-marked mold, readiness echoing with cosmic potential, shaping yet to begin.

name: Copper Ingot
description: Irregular and bright, still crusted with black slag, cooling beside open flames in the smithy.

name: Bronze Ingot
description: Rough and pitted, nestling in a bed of straw for slow cooling, awaiting further shaping.

name: Iron Ingot
description: Blocky and tarnished, steam rising from its sides, still bearing marks from the casting mold.

name: Silver Ingot
description: Shining yet tarnished, edges unfinished, resting in a basin of enchanted water—arcane etchings beginning to appear.

name: Gold Ingot
description: Heavy and radiant, cooling in a stone trough, surface swirling with hints of enchantment, unfinished purity.

name: Star Metal Ingot
description: Shot through with veins of starlight, humming gently, not yet ground nor ready for legendary forging.

name: Copper Bar
description: Raw and reddish, resting on a blacksmith’s bench, lightly tarnished and still warm from the mold.

name: Bronze Bar
description: Golden-brown and roughly rectangular, casting lines visible, set in a stack beside bellows, unshaped.

name: Iron Bar
description: Dull gray and heavy, cooling on a battered anvil, flecks of slag clinging to its edge, not yet refined.

name: Silver Bar
description: Gleaming but unpolished, freshly poured onto a stone slab, trace amounts of flux on the sides, beginnings of enchantment shimmering within.

name: Gold Bar
description: Deep yellow and faintly glimmering, resting atop silk in a noble’s vault, ends unfinished, warmth radiating.

name: Star Metal Bar
description: Black with shifting nebula gleam, pulsing slightly, forged but not cut, runes faintly visible in the cool dusk of the forge.

name: Copper Alloy Dust
description: A scattered pile of dull dust glinting faintly on a cluttered blacksmith’s anvil, not yet ready for the crucible.

name: Bronze Alloy Dust
description: Fine greenish and coarse dust, lying in a sturdy wooden scoop beside a half-melted ingot.

name: Iron Alloy Dust
description: Dark dust sprinkled across a cracked stone countertop, motes of gray swirling in the air with every stir.

name: Silver Alloy Dust
description: Shimmering bright and pure, resting in a shallow crystal bowl, metallic grains pulsating with arcane potential.

name: Gold Alloy Dust
description: A mound of gleaming dust atop an ornate goldscale, illuminated by a shaft of sunlight—clearly unfinished, awaiting enchantment.

name: Star Metal Alloy Dust
description: Mysterious and deep blue with flecks of starlight, laid out on a rune-etched obsidian slab, softly humming with nascent energy.

name: Pine Charcoal
description: Rough chunks of gray-ash coated charcoal, piled haphazardly beside a brick kiln—wood grain still visible on many pieces, warm to the touch.

name: Oak Charcoal
description: Dense and dark, cooling in heaps across a cobblestone floor, embers winking beneath the crust but not yet casked for transport.

name: Ash Charcoal
description: Brittle and silvery, laid out in rows atop a broad iron tray, edges ragged, dust motes drifting in morning light.

name: Cedar Charcoal
description: Aromatic and reddish-black, arranged in neat rows on a perfumed board, smoke still curling faintly, awaiting magical infusion.

name: Ebony Charcoal
description: Hard and shadow-deep, freshly drawn from an ornate arcane brazier, its core glimmering with latent energy, ready to serve grander crafts.

name: Worldroot Charcoal
description: Ancient and rune-scorched, each piece pulsating with primal life, heaped on a bed of moss in the heart of a grove—half charcoal, half relic.

name: Pine Firewood
description: Resinous and fragrant, freshly split with sap still dripping, stacked haphazardly beneath a timber eave.

name: Oak Firewood
description: Heavy and dark, bark peeling, logs arranged neatly on a wagon, edges rough and not yet seasoned.

name: Ash Firewood
description: Pale and splintered, small logs grouped atop a chopping block, dust swirling—wood still green.

name: Cedar Firewood
description: Streaked red and gold, aromatic oils yet to be released, logs in tidy piles next to a stone hearth.

name: Ebony Firewood
description: Jet-black and glossy, tough fibers resisting the axe, fanned out on an obsidian slab, magic latent within.

name: Worldroot Firewood
description: Twisted and engraved with faint runes, bark throbbing with green light, stacked at the edge of an ancient living circle, unfinished and powerfully alive.

name: Pine Plank
description: Soft and pale, knots and bark along the edges, stacked loosely beneath sawdust-covered rafters.

name: Oak Plank
description: Heavy, hard-grained, ends rough-cut and uneven, propped on a carpenter’s sawhorse, some bark clinging.

name: Ash Plank
description: Straight and smooth, pale sapwood showing, lying flat, not yet sanded or joined, fresh from the mill.

name: Cedar Plank
description: Reddish and aromatic, thin shavings along one side, waiting finishing strokes beside a carving knife.

name: Ebony Plank
description: Black, weighty, glossy surface marred by crude saw marks, positioned on display for final selection.

name: Worldroot Plank
description: Ancient and rune-carved, alive with faint green light, twisted edges spreading over an arcane workbench, awaiting shaping for legendary works.

name: Pine Beam
description: Rough-cut, pale and resinous, stacked on a carpenter’s bench, fresh sawdust scattered alongside.

name: Oak Beam
description: Massive, gnarled and heavy, propped on stone blocks, showing recent chisel marks from work in progress.

name: Ash Beam
description: Pale and smooth, set across a sawbuck, its ends still raw and unshaped.

name: Cedar Beam
description: Red-toned and aromatic, lying flat on a joiner’s floor, with unfinished notches awaiting joinery.

name: Ebony Beam
description: Lustrous and dark as midnight, set across golden clamps, the grain barely revealed through the first shavings.

name: Worldroot Beam
description: Majestic and swirling with ancient runes and untamed grain, sprawled across a circle of rune stones—a relic halfway between forest and artifact.

name: Pine Reinforced Frame
description: Light wood with fresh resin, iron brackets loosely attached, corners unpainted, propped against the workshop wall.

name: Oak Reinforced Frame
description: Thick and knotty, beams crisscrossed and clamped, metal joinery exposed, sturdiness aborning.

name: Ash Reinforced Frame
description: Pale and elegant, laths loosely bound with leather thongs, iron nails only half driven, unfinished structure apparent.

name: Cedar Reinforced Frame
description: Aromatic and reddish, joined with bronze rods, shavings on the floor, bulk unshaped.

name: Ebony Reinforced Frame
description: Glossy black wood braced with silver inlays, mortised joints still disassembled, laid in intricate patterns, awaiting assembly.

name: Worldroot Reinforced Frame
description: Gnarled and rune-etched, pulsing with living power, iron bands hovering nearby, mystical joinings incomplete—not yet awakened.

name: Crude Writer's Table
description: Battered planks and mismatched legs, ink stains spattered, with nails sticking out and tasks abandoned mid-assembly.

name: Oak Writer's Table
description: Robust but rough, rich brown grains exposed, surface half-planed, tool marks everywhere.

name: Ash Writer's Table
description: Pale and elegant, legs unjoined and writing surface uneven, sawdust across the top.

name: Cedar Writer's Table
description: Red-toned planks perfumed and aromatic, drawer fronts open with bare wood showing, filigree carving incomplete.

name: Ebony Writer's Table
description: Glossy black wood under a fine layer of dust, delicate inlay half-finished, awaiting final polish.

name: Worldroot Writer's Table
description: Sprawling roots and mystical symbols etched across its broad unfinished surface, magical energies pooling as it’s assembled.

name: Small Bone Shard
description: Chalky and sharp, sitting amid a scatter of chips, unfinished and slightly bloodstained from recent carving.

name: Large Bone Shard
description: Jagged and heavy, sprawling on a butcher’s table, yet to be filed or shaped.

name: Beast Bone Shard
description: Thick and twisted, jumbled amid a nest of sinew and splinters on a craftsman’s bench.

name: Monster Bone Shard
description: Grotesque and spined, partially cleaned but still rough, abandoned mid-cut.

name: Ancient Bone Shard
description: Yellowed and runic-etched, half-buried in sawdust, timeworn but unrefined.

name: Dragon Bone Shard
description: Gleaming with a translucent sheen and edged in gold, lying on a silk cloth, unfinished but brimming with mythic promise.

name: Small Bone Blade
description: Pale and jagged, laying on a bench, freshly carved and unpolished, splinters yet to be sanded away.

name: Large Bone Blade
description: Heavy and unwieldy, resting atop a stained leather mat, its edge still marked by rough carving.

name: Beast Bone Blade
description: Curved and robust, with notches yet to be filed smooth, pinned beneath iron clamps.

name: Monster Bone Blade
description: Massive and serrated, mounted on a blacksmith’s anvil, partially ground, primitive power apparent.

name: Ancient Bone Blade
description: Dense with fossil veins, lying unfinished amid mystic runes, not yet unleashed to the world.

name: Wyrm Bone Blade
description: Sinuous and elongated, marbled with iridescent veins, awaiting final polishing beside a glowing forge.

name: Hemp Thread
description: Greenish and rough, loosely twisted and sitting on a carving bench, tips fraying, not yet spooled.

name: Cotton Thread
description: Soft white and slightly fluffy, looped over a spindle, with bits of seed yet to be carded out.

name: Wool Thread
description: Off-white and fuzzy, strands newly spun and lying coiled, some tufts still showing natural lanolin.

name: Silk Thread
description: Pearly and glistening, smooth but unspooled, shining faintly at the edge of a weaver’s loom, not yet wound into skeins.

name: Shadow Thread
description: Jet-black and whisper-thin, trailing from the maw of a shadowy distaff, ends unraveling into mist, not yet woven.

name: Moon Thread
description: Glowing silver-blue, floating above an enchanted spindle, lengths swirling in lunar patterns, unfinished and haunting.

name: Hemp Cloth
description: Rough and coarse, spun in uneven weave, pieces rolled atop a market cart with stray stalks caked in.

name: Cotton Cloth
description: Creamy and soft, broad bolts resting in a weaving basket, threads sticking out along the frayed margin.

name: Wool Cloth
description: Thick, pale gray with nubs of lanolin, sheets half-folded and awaiting final carding and wash.

name: Silk Cloth
description: Glossy and light as air, sheer lengths draped over a maple dowel, unhemmed and trailing gossamer.

name: Shadow Cloth
description: Nearly black, with whorls of deeper darkness, folded on stone with shifting sheen, unfinished and cool.

name: Moon Cloth
description: Shimmering silver-blue, floating lightly above a rune-bound loom, motes of moonlight drifting from the edges, not yet cut.

name: Hemp Sponge
description: Pale green and coarse, recently netted and wrung, drying on a rough wooden rack, fibers tangled and soft.

name: Cotton Sponge
description: Fluffy white and springy, soaking in a basin of clear water, portions uncut, naturally absorbent.

name: Wool Sponge
description: Gray and slightly oily, loosely packed and drying on a clay tile, scent of lanolin rising, yet to be shaped.

name: Silk Sponge
description: Pearly smooth and shimmering, draped over a bronze rod by a window, flowing edges untrimmed and delicate.

name: Shadow Sponge
description: Deep black and cool to the touch, light pooling on its surface, ethereal strands swirling, not yet contained.

name: Moon Sponge
description: Silver-white with glints of iridescence, luminescent motes drifting from its surface, floating in a crystal bowl, far from finished.

name: Healing Herb Extract
description: Bright green and cloudy, swirling in a half-corked glass bottle, droplets still condensing on the neck.

name: Bitterroot Extract
description: Amber and dense, seeping through filter paper atop a copper funnel, essence pooling gradually below.

name: Nightshade Extract
description: Dark violet and viscous, oozing down the side of a crooked flask, mixing forbidden scents with cool night air.

name: Fireleaf Extract
description: Glowing red in a narrow alembic, vapors swirling within, warmth radiating but the process unfinished.

name: Starblossom Extract
description: Pale blue and faintly sparkling, resting in a silver phial adorned with unfinished runes, essence yet to be decanted.

name: Dreamcap Extract
description: Misty and opaline, contained within a corked round flask, somnolent fog swirling—alchemy only halfway complete.

name: Healing Herb Paste
description: Bright green with uneven texture, mashed in a chipped mortar, fragments of leaf and stem still visible, unfinished.

name: Bitterroot Paste
description: Gritty and brown, heaped in a wooden spoon, not yet spread or blended into tonics.

name: Nightshade Paste
description: Midnight-purple and viscous, clinging to a pestle, fumes rising from the bowl—lethal and not fully ground.

name: Fireleaf Paste
description: Glowing red and fiery-hot, streaked in a clay bowl, embers crackling on the surface, pungency unfinished.

name: Starblossom Paste
description: Luminous blue and silky, newly scraped into an opal jar, faint stardust swirling above, still settling.

name: Dreamcap Paste
description: Misty gray with silver motes, scooped in a crystal dish, strange vapors spiraling up, not yet stabilized for use.

name: Healing Herb Spice
description: Green and crumbled, spread in a rough heap atop a linen cloth, herbal aroma yet to be sealed.

name: Bitterroot Spice
description: Earthy and dark brown, scattered loosely inside a cracked clay basin, bitterness lingering in the air.

name: Nightshade Spice
description: Deep purple grains, drying on a shaded rack, dangerous shimmer untouched, not yet measured for concoctions.

name: Fireleaf Spice
description: Bright red slivers exuding warmth, cooling beside a flame-forged skillet, scent smoldering, not quite ready for the mortar.

name: Starblossom Spice
description: Pale blue tufts sparkling faintly, gently heaped in a crystalline bowl, starlight glimmering off unfinished edges.

name: Dreamcap Spice
description: Misty gray flakes, loosely gathered in a woven pouch, moonlit motes drifting off, awaiting refinement for potions or food.

name: Dressed Rabbit

name: Dressed Boar

name: Dressed Elk
description: Antlers intact, sinew and muscle visible, hide sloughing away, suspended from a hook in a cool cellar, uncarved.

name: Dressed Griffin
description: Down feathers plucked but wings left whole, talons shining, body stretched across a rune-marked table, magical energies lingering.

name: Dressed Wyvern
description: Grayish scales and membranous wings partially removed, coiled upon a tiled floor, violet blood trickling from its maw.

name: Dressed Dragon
description: Colossal limbs disjointed, emerald scales and sinew exposed, laid on a dais of stone, preparation incomplete and awe-inspiring.

name: Rabbit Carcass
description: Limp and freshly slain, arranged atop a blood-stained wooden board, fur ruffled and eyes unclosed, untouched by the butcher’s knife.

name: Boar Carcass
description: Bristly and mud-caked, sprawled across a slab of rough stone, tusks yet to be removed, bearing the marks of fresh hunts.

name: Elk Carcass
description: Hulking, antlers tangled in burlap, hooves dangling over the butcher’s rack—muscle unsliced, hide still damp with dew.

name: Griffin Carcass
description: Feathered and majestic, wings half-folded, talons curled, sprawled atop a gilded table, magical essence only beginning to wane—awaiting further preparation.

name: Wyvern Carcass
description: Serpent-like and scaled, barbed tail and venomous fangs unfurled on a rune-stamped iron grating, arcane energies lingering faintly, unprocessed.

name: Dragon Carcass
description: Colossal and awe-inspiring, gleaming with ancient scales and smoldering wounds, stretched across an altar of black stone, not yet harvested for its legendary hoard.

name: Cooked Rabbit

name: Cooked Boar
description: A richly caramelized haunch, resting atop heated rocks, the aroma heartily wild, awaiting the carver’s blade and final garnishing.

name: Cooked Elk
description: Thick cuts steaming atop a pine plank, edges seared but interiors faintly rosy, not yet sliced for service.

name: Cooked Griffin
description: Gold-feathered breast, aromatic, cooling on a silver tray, shimmering oils collecting beneath, ready for the feasting hall.

name: Cooked Wyvern
description: Scaled and succulent tail, piping hot on a drake-bone platter, faint wisps of magic still rising from within the flesh.

name: Cooked Dragon
description: An immense and marbled rib, blazing atop a rune-engraved slab, rare and crackling with mystical flames—awaits only a hero to claim it.

name: Baked Grain Bread

name: Baked Root Vegetable

name: Baked Wild Mushroom

name: Baked Orchard Fruit
description: Glazed and caramelized, heaped in a carved wooden bowl, wafting sweet scents but not yet served.

name: Baked Honeycomb
description: Dripping golden slabs, sticky and cooling on a latticed rack, raw honey still seeping but the dish unassembled.

name: Baked Ambrosia
description: Glowing faintly gold on a tray, edges crisp but the center soft, the divine treat unfinished atop a marble counter.

name: Cut Quartz Crystal

name: Cut Amethyst Crystal

name: Cut Sapphire Crystal

name: Cut Ruby Crystal

name: Cut Mana Crystal

name: Cut Astral Crystal
description: Clear with shimmering starbursts, balancing on an ethereal loom, otherworldly glow incomplete—awaiting the touch of a master enchanter.

name: Quartz Arcane Dust

name: Amethyst Arcane Dust

name: Sapphire Arcane Dust
description: Deep blue grains pooled in a brass mortar, half-ground by a mage’s pestle, awaiting further refinement.

name: Ruby Arcane Dust
description: Luminous crimson, piled unceremoniously in a silver spoon, sparkling with arcane promise but unfinished.

name: Mana Arcane Dust

name: Astral Arcane Dust
description: Silvery and shimmering, gathered in a moonlit bowl, wisps rising and fading, as if not fully of this world.

name: Trimmed Rabbit Pelt

name: Trimmed Fox Pelt
description: Russet-red and bushy, lying draped over a wooden bench, patches of longer fur needing care.

name: Trimmed Wolf Pelt

name: Trimmed Warg Pelt

name: Trimmed Frostmane Pelt

name: Deer Leather

name: Goat Leather

name: Elk Leather

name: Manticore Leather

name: Wyvern Leather

name: Phoenix Leather

name: Sparrow Feather Thread

name: Owl Feather Thread

name: Hawk Feather Thread

name: Phoenix Feather Thread

name: Roc Feather Thread

name: Celestial Feather Thread

name: Wyvern Tail Charm

name: Gorgon Scale Charm

name: Umbral Heart Charm

name: Worldclay Brick

name: Quartz Glass Pane

name: Obsidian Glass Pane

description: Clear and glossy, pooled thickly at the base of a wooden brush, open pot on a paint-splattered shelf.

name: Plant Dye Lacquer
description: Green-tinted and aromatic, dripped across a raw wood panel, color deepening but finish tacky to the touch.

name: Mineral Lacquer
description: Blue-gray hues swirling, half-brushed onto a cracked ceramic mask, surface not yet dry.

name: Rare Lacquer
description: Deep violet shimmering with faint sparkles, oozing from a silver-bound jar, already capturing light but curing incomplete.

name: Phoenix Ash Lacquer
description: Swirling with gold and red, coating a rune-carved box in fiery sheens, still warm, flames flickering at edges.

name: Chromatic Lacquer
description: Prismatic and vibrant, running down a cloth-wrapped brush, pooled on a tile and shimmering with all colors as it dries unfinished.

name: Distilled Faint Essence
description: A misty liquid swirling at the bottom of a glass vial, barely visible and yet uncorked, hovering over a cool marble slab.

name: Distilled Elemental Essence
description: Flecks of flame, water, earth, and air trapped in a flask, the elements roiling but not yet unified or infused.

name: Distilled Spirit Essence
description: Pale blue vapor twisting within a sealed decanter, flashing with ephemeral faces, the binding wax still unset.

name: Distilled Planar Essence
description: Colors shifting between realities in a warped glass flask, world echoes flickering within—process not yet stabilized.

name: Distilled Primordial Essence
description: Seething in a titan-sized jar, raw chaos crackling from its center, its form uncontained and just barely bottled.

name: Distilled Void Essence
description: An ink-black droplet levitating in a crystal sphere, tendrils reaching into shadow—extraction unfinished, reality bending around it.

name: Assembled Rusty Gearwork
description: A jumble of pitted cogs and misshapen springs, laid open on an oil-stained rag, many teeth still unwelded.

name: Assembled Bronze Clockwork
description: Intricate wheels and rods gleaming, half-joined around a central axis—parts misaligned, assembly incomplete.

name: Assembled Precision Gearwork
description: Silvery and compact, interconnected but not yet housed within a casing, gears exposed on a velvet mat.

name: Assembled Runic Clockwork
description: Etched with swirling glyphs, ticking with subtle magical rhythms, but key components lie unfastened, waiting the mage-smith’s hand.

name: Assembled Arcane Clockwork
description: Interlaced with wires of glowing ether, alive with swirling lights, the main gear floating above a runic ring—energy connections unfinished.

name: Assembled Worldforge Mechanism
description: Colossal and primordial, forged from metals unknown, gears thrumming with the pulse of the earth, sprawled across an anvil veined with ley lines—just beginning to awaken.

name: Rusty Gearwork Gearbox
description: A battered steel box with corroded cogs spilling from its open case, oil pooled beneath, gears still jammed and assembly incomplete.

name: Bronze Clockwork Gearbox
description: Shining dully, inner wheels laid bare, elegant teeth partly aligned but pins and screws scattered on a velvet-lined worktable.

name: Precision Gearwork Gearbox
description: Sleek brushed-metal housing, exposed spinning gears microns apart, loose springs beside, some segments yet to be secured.

name: Runic Clockwork Gearbox
description: Intricate gears marked with mysterious glyphs, powered by faint magical glow, crystalline bearings half-set, spellwork unfinished.

name: Arcane Clockwork Gearbox
description: Radiating with pulsing glyph-lights, wires trailing to open runestones, parts hovering by unseen force, mechanism incomplete.

name: Worldforge Mechanism Gearbox
description: Massive stone-and-metal structure veined with elemental fire, ancient gears half-integrated, leylines pulsing beneath, primed for further assembly.

name: Sundried Chitin Plate
description: Pale yellow and brittle, hanging from a sunbeam-lit rack, edges curling as it dries, yet to be shaped by armorers.

name: Brine-Cured Chitin Plate
description: Greenish and slick, submerged halfway in a salt-filled trough, glistening with droplets, the curing not yet complete.

name: Smoke-Cured Chitin Plate
description: Deep brown and slightly warped, balanced atop a smoky rack, scent of resin lingering—still flexible, not cut to form.

name: Hardened Chitin Plate
description: Black and iron-tough, locked in a crate of iron bands, the process unfinished, surface awaiting etching for magical runes.

name: Resin-Sealed Chitin Plate
description: Shimmering under a glass dome, amber resin oozing around the edges but not yet cured, spellwork half-finished.

name: Voidwrought Chitin Plate
description: Inky and iridescent, suspended in a web of silver wire, energies from beyond flickering across its surface—halfway between matter and myth.

name: Lashed Panel
description: Rough planks bound together with rawhide cords, knots loose and edges uneven—structure incomplete.

name: Bound Panel
description: Reinforced with leather straps, ends protruding and seams askew, spread on a splattered workbench.

name: Laminated Panel
description: Thin layers of wood glued but not pressed, surfaces still sticky and curling at the corners atop a craftsman’s table.

name: Trussed Panel
description: Supported with crude beams and rope, form evident but fastenings not tensioned, lying in a half-built frame.

name: Girded Panel
description: Rimmed with iron bands, bolts and rivets not yet tightened, propped upright for inspection.

name: Bulwark Panel
description: Massive and multi-layered, embedded with rune stones, bracing rods sticking out, unfinished yet imposing.

name: Cinched Lining
description: Rough fabric gathered with basic cord, bunched atop a seamstress’s bench, loose threads dangling, not yet set into a garment.

name: Padded Lining
description: Thick layers of wool unevenly quilted, tossed in a pile beside needlework tools, some sections unstitched, awaiting placement.

name: Layered Lining
description: Multiple cloth layers pinned together, edges misaligned across the cutting board, in mid-assembly—awaiting final sewing.

name: Stitched Lining
description: Rows of uneven hand-stitches visible, stretched over an armrest mold, some seams still unfinished.

name: Corded Lining
description: Thick cords threaded but not fully laced, parts still spilling out over a loom, ready to be shaped and affixed.

name: Braced Lining
description: Woven with stiff supports and bone strips, arrayed flat on a workbench, fastenings not yet secured.

name: Cleaned Stream Minnow
description: An array of silvery and slender fish, laid side-by-side on a worn plank, skins sparkling but bones yet to be removed.

name: Cleaned River Trout
description: Pink-fleshed and unseasoned, placed askew atop a mossy camp stone, scales absent but unused for stew.

name: Cleaned Sea Salmon
description: Cleaned and plump, resting belly-up in a shallow copper basin—gills red, but fillets not yet sliced.

name: Cleaned Runic Eel
description: Long and iridescent, looped within a rune-carved trough, faint glyphs glowing along its spine—unfinished, still exuding electric arcs.

name: Cleaned Umbral Anglerfish
description: Bulbous and black, fangs exposed upon a crystal board, faint otherworldly illumination gleaming from its lure, awaiting arcane extraction.

name: Cleaned Abyssal Leviathan
description: A monstrous rib section cleaned but not butchered fully, its immense form curled in a boat-shaped trough, scales laced with eldritch sigils, preparation only begun.

name: Tallow Oil
description: A murky, pale yellow liquid slowly collecting in a rough clay jar, thick drops still dripping from a greasy iron cauldron—animal scent lingers, vessel unsealed.

name: Pressed Oil
description: Golden, cloudy liquid trickling into a squat wooden tub from a primitive screw press, flecks of seed and pulp floating on the surface, extraction unfinished.

name: Refined Lamp Oil
description: Clear and pale, poured midway into a glass bottle, unstoppered, a funnel and stained rag aside, some haze still swirling—process incomplete.

name: Sacred Oil
description: Faintly glowing, pooling inside an open silver chalice atop a stone altar, petals and herbs floating on the surface, ritual markings unfinished—anointing still to come.

name: Phoenix Oil
description: Iridescent, fiery liquid seething in a charred bronze flask, smoky wisps hovering above, drops hissing where they touch bare stone—harvest incomplete, heat undimmed.

name: Starfire Oil
description: Ethereal, silvery-blue and swirling with tiny starlit motes, decanting from a crystal ampoule into a rune-marked dish, celestial glow pulsing—bottling not yet done.

name: Pine Arrow
description: Pale, sap-scented shaft, rough-hewn and light, unfinished wooden arrowpoint, untied fletchings of mottled gray feather scattered on the workbench.

name: Oak Arrow
description: Heavy and dark-shafted, knotted wood, arrowhead only loosely fitted, tail end ringed with a single half-attached brown feather.

name: Ash Arrow
description: Slender, flexible shaft resting atop a leather pad, crude iron head beside it, feather vanes untrimmed, arrangement unfinished.

name: Cedar Arrow
description: Red-toned and aromatic, notched but lacking a tip, a scatter of red feather plumes and binding twine at its base.

name: Ebony Arrow
description: Jet-black, gleaming shaft, arrowhead half-inserted, stark white binding thread and dark glossy feathers lying nearby, all slightly askew.

name: Worldroot Arrow
description: Intricately veined ancient wood shaft, pulsing with faint green glow, featherless and headless, delicate runes swirling along unfinished sides.

name: Pine Bolt
description: Stubby and pale, freshly cut with a flat tip unfinished, bark remnants clinging near the nock, scattered alongside simple iron points.

name: Oak Bolt
description: Short and thick-shafted, coarse and weighty, tip unshod, fletching string still tangled, waiting for assembly.

name: Ash Bolt
description: Long and straight, resting next to chisel marks, ends blunt, tail feathers laid in a bunch, binding sinew trailing off its end.

name: Cedar Bolt
description: Rich and red-streaked, half-fletched, shaft glistening with resin, a small pile of feathers and glue nearby, incomplete.

name: Ebony Bolt
description: Dense and dark-shafted, one end carved to a stub, heavy head only partly attached, black and white flights curled loosely around the body.

name: Worldroot Bolt
description: Ancient and rune-etched, shaft entwined with faint green light, wood still alive, mechanism unexplained—head and fletching not present, radiating potential.
